payload.body: You tend to say you are fine until a basic need changes your whole mood. Hunger, rest, privacy, reassurance, or time alone can become difficult to ask for directly, even when the need itself is simple. This often begins with learning that your feelings were too much, badly timed, or inconvenient for the people around you. Name the need while it is still small enough to say in one sentence.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct the Moon can make private needs feel urgent when they have been hidden or treated as unacceptable.
